training.schedule: 2 epoch warmup then cosine to 0.05 at epoch60
training.selection: validation BA then OA then lower NLL
training.normalization: Full-compatible /255, gray replicated RGB, ImageNet mean/std
training.augmentation: paired 90-degree rotations and horizontal flip; native scale unchanged
training.loss: class and vessel balanced CE, same source-weight rule as Full
training.bn: all running statistics frozen; affine trainable only within late/full scopes
training.input: same native160; valid-area global pooling; availability-masked concatenation
training.precision: bfloat16 convolution training; float32 pooling/head and evaluation

test_policy: only selected scope/LR three seeds, after all validation selection
